sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 150)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American and international networks, Jay Jostyn busting a defense plant payoff racket on *Mr. District Attorney* for Vitalis, Charles Webster and Julie Stevens solving a trunk murder on *The Abbott Mysteries* for Helbros Watches, two sparkling *Skippy Hollywood Theatre* productions starring Jane Wyatt and Dan Duryea for Skippy Peanut Butter, South Africa's domestic comedy *Little Things in Life*, and *Plantation Jubilee* (1942–1975):
